recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑明顯增粗、形狀不規則並彼此吻合連結，占去大部分髓腔（osteosclerosis）；小樑間的造血組織夾雜漩渦狀、呈束狀排列的細胞與纖維化區域，提示晚期骨髓增生性腫瘤（如真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化）。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying a large proportion of the marrow space
Trabeculae show lamellar bone with scattered osteocyte lacunae
Intertrabecular spaces contain cellular areas with streaming, whorled, fibrotic stroma
Dilated sinusoids and scattered adipocytes between trabeculae
Individual megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, irregular, and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying a large portion of the marrow space. The intertrabecular marrow contains cellular areas with a streaming, whorled stromal pattern suggestive of fibrosis, along with dilated sinusoids and scattered adipocytes. Megakaryocyte detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and reticulin and trichrome stains are required to grade the fibrosis. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic phase of a myeloproliferative neoplasm, such as post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in the given clinical context.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests within desmoplastic stroma that are keratin positive, unlike the hematopoietic streaming here.
Renal osteodystrophy shows osteoclastic tunneling resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis rather than marrow replacement by an MPN with atypical megakaryocytes.
Paget disease has a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines with active osteoclasts and osteoblasts, and an otherwise normal hematopoietic marrow.
Mastocytosis can cause osteosclerosis but shows paratrabecular aggregates of spindled CD117+/tryptase+ mast cells with eosinophils.
